title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_omega_by_ruediger_dahlke_veit_lindau_wndky (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_omega_by_ruediger_dahlke_veit_lindau_wndky' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package results in full system compromise, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets from a separate, uncompromised device due to the risk of persistent malicious software.
